# masterdaweb_regions (Data Source)

The regions (datacenters) instances are placed in: region_id of masterdaweb_instance and masterdaweb_vpc.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_regions" "open" {
  available = true
}

output "regions" {
  value = { for r in data.masterdaweb_regions.open.regions : r.region_name => r.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `available` (Boolean) true: only the regions new instances can be placed in right now.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always regions.
- `regions` (Attributes List) The regions, by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether new instances can be placed in it right now (false: full for now, not gone).
- `id` (String) The region's id (region_id).
- `ipv4_available` (Boolean) Whether a public IPv4 address can be had in it.
- `ipv6_available` (Boolean) Whether an IPv6 address can be had in it.
- `name` (String) Its name, like São Paulo.
- `region_name` (String) Its short name, like br-sp.
